name: Electrician License
description: How to transfer an electrician license between US states.
longDescription: Electricians are licensed state by state, and each state sets its own license levels and reciprocity terms. PermitBridge publishes an electrician transfer page only after checking the requirements against the licensing board's own source.

faqs.question: Does Texas have electrician reciprocity with other states?
faqs.answer: Only with specific states. TDLR's out-of-state page lists Journeyman Electrician reciprocity with Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Idaho, Iowa, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, South Dakota and Wyoming, and Master Electrician reciprocity with Alabama, Arkansas, Iowa, Louisiana, Nebraska, North Carolina, Ohio and Tennessee.
